risk: Detection accuracy too low in Indian glare, dust, rain and night
mitigation: India-specific dataset (1,000 h, 40% night/rain); HDR camera; scenario test suite (Week 4)
contingency: Add 77 GHz radar variant for fleets; limit features in bad weather

mitigation: Thresholds from trade-off analysis (Week 3: 0.85 FCW nuisance/h); < 1 false alert/h as a release gate
contingency: Per-fleet tuning; driver can lower sensitivity of advisories

risk: Heat failures in hot cabins (70 °C parked)
mitigation: Thermal budget (Week 3: 76 °C case at 50 °C cabin); summer pilot in Indore and Nagpur; reduced start mode
contingency: Add passive heat sink; restrict peak-load features

cause: Weak pilot results or market downturn
mitigation: Stage-gated spending; raise seed for P0-P2 only; milestone M5 as the proof point
contingency: Cut P5 scope; extend runway by 6 months with a smaller team

risk: Drivers resist in-cabin cameras (privacy, surveillance fears)
mitigation: On-device processing; event-only clips with consent (DPDP Act); coaching, not penalties; drivers see their own data
contingency: Offer forward-only mode; union and driver-council engagement

risk: AI chip shortage or price rise
mitigation: Qualify two SoC vendors; hardware abstraction layer; 6-month buffer stock at launch
contingency: Switch to second vendor (8-week port plan)

risk: Certification at ARAI/ICAT takes longer than 6 months
mitigation: Pre-compliance EMC tests in P1; early engagement; design to AIS and UN R155/R156 from day one
contingency: Two-month buffer in P3; launch fleet product (aftermarket accessory) first

risk: Poor installations in the aftermarket (wrong angle, loose power)
mitigation: Installer certification; guided calibration app; installation photo check
contingency: Remote diagnostics and re-visit within 48 h

risk: OEMs and global Tier-1s launch cheaper factory ADAS
mitigation: Focus on retrofit and fleets (installed base of millions); license the software stack to OEMs

risk: Fleet sales cycle longer than planned (6+ months)
mitigation: Pilot customers become references; ROI calculator (fuel, insurance, downtime); 30-day free trial
ESOPs; documentation and pair ownership of every model; university partnerships
Secure boot, signed OTA, TLS, penetration tests every release
contingency: Remote kill-switch for connectivity; incident response plan

risk: Liability claim after a missed warning
mitigation: Warning-only positioning; clear user agreement; safety case documentation; product liability insurance
Clear labelling guide; 10% audit sample; auto-labelling and active learning

risk: DPDP rules require changes to data handling
cause: New rules or Data Protection Board guidance
mitigation: Privacy by design; data minimisation; consent management built in
contingency: Rapid OTA update of data flows
